description: This PHP class 'PsrHttpFactoryHelper' provides utility methods to convert between Symfony HttpFoundation Request/Response objects and PSR-7 Request/Response objects, utilizing the Nyholm PSR-7 factories and Symfony PSR bridge factories. It facilitates interoperability between Symfony HTTP components and PSR-7 standards in the OAuth plugin.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: A helper class to convert requests and responses between Symfony HttpFoundation objects and PSR-7 interfaces, enabling interoperability between different HTTP message implementations.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a PsrHttpFactory instance for creating PSR-7 request and response objects.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Returns an instance of HttpFoundationFactory, creating it if not already initialized.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Request object into a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface object.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Response object into a PSR-7 ResponseInterface object.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Request object from a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface object.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Response object from a PSR-7 ResponseInterface object.
